import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Ensure 'Stress Level' is treated as a categorical variable for proper ordering on the x-axis
# Convert to category and reorder to ensure numerical sorting
df['Stress Level'] = df['Stress Level'].astype('category')
df['Stress Level'] = df['Stress Level'].cat.reorder_categories(sorted(df['Stress Level'].unique()))

# Set a visually appealing style for the plots
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a figure with two subplots side-by-side
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 7), sharey=False) # sharey=False as the y-axes scales are different

# Plot 1: Violin plot for Sleep Duration distribution by Stress Level
sns.violinplot(ax=axes[0], data=df, x='Stress Level', y='Sleep Duration', palette='viridis', inner='quartile')
axes[0].set_title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by Stress Level', fontsize=14)
axes[0].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0].tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=10)
axes[0].tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=10)
axes[0].grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)

# Plot 2: Violin plot for Quality of Sleep distribution by Stress Level
sns.violinplot(ax=axes[1], data=df, x='Stress Level', y='Quality of Sleep', palette='magma', inner='quartile')
axes[1].set_title('Distribution of Quality of Sleep by Stress Level', fontsize=14)
axes[1].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)

# Adjust layout to prevent overlapping elements, especially the suptitle
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.98])

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Plot 1: Violin plot for Sleep Duration distribution by Stress Level

axes[0].set_title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by Stress Level', fontsize=14)
axes[0].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0].tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=10)
axes[0].tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=10)
axes[0].grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)

# Plot 2: Violin plot for Quality of Sleep distribution by Stress Level
sns.violinplot(ax=axes[1], data=df, x='Stress Level', y='Quality of Sleep', palette='magma', inner='quartile')
axes[1].set_title('Distribution of Quality of Sleep by Stress Level', fontsize=14)
axes[1].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[1].tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=10)
axes[1].tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=10)
axes[1].grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)

# Add a main title for the entire figure

# Adjust layout to prevent overlapping elements, especially the suptitle

# Save the figure
